metadata.description: Astra marketplace for Claude Code: unified engineering OS (`devcrew` — dispatcher-guided crew workflow + spec-driven autonomous dev engine) and AstraMemory bridge (`astramem`). Central registry — plugins live in their own repos.

plugins.name: devcrew
plugins.description: Unified engineering OS for Claude Code: dispatcher-guided workflow with bounded subagents, parallel quality gates, and inspectable handoffs (formerly `crew`) plus a spec-driven agentic development engine — free-text intake, PM-triaged backlog, slice-scoped Given-When-Then specs, parallel-worktree wave dispatch, phase-gate quality + review + validation, and decision-grade retros (formerly `runner`). One plugin, one release train.

plugins.name: astramem
plugins.description: Slash commands (/astramem:recall, /astramem:remember) + the using-memory skill + auto-capture hooks + astramem CLI provider selector (local vs SaaS) + MCP tools (agent_profile, recall_memory, search_memory, remember, submit_feedback). Bun-native TypeScript.
